# cdngslb.com
> CDN GSLB provides global server load balancing and traffic management services for directing users to optimal endpoints.

The site focuses on DNS-based global load balancing, health checks, failover, and traffic steering for high availability and performance across distributed infrastructure.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://www.cdngslb.com/): Overview of CDN GSLB services, traffic management capabilities, and platform positioning.
- [About](https://www.cdngslb.com/about): Background information about the company, platform, and service mission.
- [Contact](https://www.cdngslb.com/contact): Contact details and inquiry options for sales, support, or partnership requests.
- [Pricing](https://www.cdngslb.com/pricing): Service plan and pricing information for CDN GSLB offerings.

## Product
- [Global Server Load Balancing](https://www.cdngslb.com/global-server-load-balancing): Product overview for DNS-based global traffic distribution and endpoint selection.
- [Traffic Management](https://www.cdngslb.com/traffic-management): Details on routing policies, geographic steering, and traffic control features.
- [Health Checks](https://www.cdngslb.com/health-checks): Information on endpoint monitoring, availability detection, and automated failover triggers.
- [Failover](https://www.cdngslb.com/failover): Explanation of failover behavior for maintaining service continuity during outages.
- [Geo Routing](https://www.cdngslb.com/geo-routing): Geographic routing capabilities for directing users to regionally appropriate infrastructure.

## Features
- [DNS Load Balancing](https://www.cdngslb.com/dns-load-balancing): Feature page describing DNS-based balancing across multiple origins or data centers.
- [Latency-Based Routing](https://www.cdngslb.com/latency-based-routing): Routing based on performance characteristics to improve end-user response times.
- [Weighted Routing](https://www.cdngslb.com/weighted-routing): Traffic distribution using configurable weights across available endpoints.
- [Automatic Failover](https://www.cdngslb.com/automatic-failover): Automated traffic redirection when health checks detect endpoint failures.
- [Multi-Region Delivery](https://www.cdngslb.com/multi-region-delivery): Support for resilient service delivery across geographically distributed regions.

## Solutions
- [High Availability](https://www.cdngslb.com/solutions/high-availability): Use cases for improving uptime with redundant endpoints and intelligent routing.
- [Disaster Recovery](https://www.cdngslb.com/solutions/disaster-recovery): Guidance on using GSLB for recovery planning and outage mitigation.
- [Multi-Cloud Traffic Steering](https://www.cdngslb.com/solutions/multi-cloud): Traffic management across providers and regions for resilience and flexibility.
- [Global Application Delivery](https://www.cdngslb.com/solutions/global-application-delivery): Solution overview for optimizing worldwide application access and performance.
- [Business Continuity](https://www.cdngslb.com/solutions/business-continuity): Continuity-focused routing and failover strategies for critical services.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://www.cdngslb.com/docs): Central documentation hub for setup, configuration, and operational guidance.
- [Getting Started](https://www.cdngslb.com/docs/getting-started): Introductory guide for initial account setup and service configuration.
- [DNS Configuration](https://www.cdngslb.com/docs/dns-configuration): Instructions for configuring DNS records and traffic policies.
- [Health Check Configuration](https://www.cdngslb.com/docs/health-check-configuration): Setup details for monitoring endpoints and defining health criteria.
- [Routing Policies](https://www.cdngslb.com/docs/routing-policies): Reference for available routing methods and policy behavior.
- [Failover Setup](https://www.cdngslb.com/docs/failover-setup): Steps for configuring failover logic and backup endpoints.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.cdngslb.com/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues, diagnostics, and operational troubleshooting guidance.

## API and Integrations
- [API Overview](https://www.cdngslb.com/api): Introduction to programmatic management of CDN GSLB resources.
- [API Reference](https://www.cdngslb.com/api/reference): Endpoint-level reference for authentication, resources, and request formats.
- [Authentication](https://www.cdngslb.com/api/authentication): Details on API keys, tokens, and access control requirements.
- [DNS Records API](https://www.cdngslb.com/api/dns-records): Programmatic management of DNS records and balancing configurations.
- [Health Checks API](https://www.cdngslb.com/api/health-checks): API operations for creating and managing endpoint health monitors.
- [Webhooks](https://www.cdngslb.com/api/webhooks): Event notification and integration options for operational workflows.
